note: Verified hashtag registry. A tag is only usable if it is in the verified list below with evidence. R12 blocks anything else. No follower counts, ever: LinkedIn serves hashtag pages only to signed-in sessions, so counts cannot be verified from here and an unverifiable number is a fabricated number under R06.
verification_method: Search for live posts using the tag together with a second tag from this lane, and record who was posting. Tags seen in use by practitioners in AI evaluation, AI security and agent engineering count. A tag appearing only in a marketing campaign does not.
rules: Three to five tags, on the final line of the post.
Never more than five. Never fewer than three.
Mixed register: at least one security tag and at least one evaluation tag where the post supports it.
A tag added here needs a date, a lane, and one line of evidence. No evidence, no entry.
